name: Tamamayu ~Miserareta Mitsu no Ito~
original_name: 玉繭 ～魅せられた蜜の糸～
source:
Mysterious girl Shoko suddenly transfers to main character's school. One day she confesses to protagonist, but gets rejected. She says she has an ability to control the darkness and is drawn to protagonist's inner darkness. But her attempts of mental control get blocked. At that point Shoko starts to involve people around protagonist. Will hero engulf in darkness or break free from it?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
神秘少女坂下祥子突然转入主人公所在的学校。一天，她向主人公告白，却遭到拒绝。她自称拥有操纵黑暗的能力，并受到主人公内心黑暗的吸引。然而，她试图控制主人公精神的行动却未能奏效。于是，祥子开始把主人公身边的人也牵扯进来。主人公最终会被黑暗吞噬，还是挣脱它的束缚？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
